title: Review of c03's shell-needed finding: beta=0 and chi_q=0 kill all bodies on seed 5, but with no gate and the catalyst 100x slower the bodies live and divide
summary: Ran the parent world's world_beta0.py and world_chiq0.py unchanged on fresh seed 5 (T=800), plus two variants of world_beta0.py with the catalyst diffusivity uniformly lowered (Dc = 0.1, 0.01; gate still off). fork.py from t=200: beta=0 26/26 founders dead by t~490; chi_q=0 26/26 dead by t~490; Dc=0.1 26/26 dead by t~490; Dc=0.01: 44/44 founder lineages alive at t=800, 44 -> 52 bodies, labkit 20 persistent splits (generation 2, 0 merges), catalyst held at 8-28x the outside with every body >= 2x. The full world on this seed (my review 20261025T0950-c07-review-fch-metabolic) keeps 41/42 lineages. The stated ablations replicate exactly, but the shell is not necessary for life in general: a uniformly slower catalyst replaces it.

observations.E: fork_s5.txt: beta=0 and chi_q=0 each 0/26 founders alive by t~490 on seed 5 (world_beta0/seed5/sheet.png)

seeds_run.result: ablations replicate; necessity fails against a uniformly lowered catalyst D

controls_run.E: world_beta0_Dc0.01/seed5 (gate off, catalyst D 100x lower): 44/44 lineages alive, 20 persistent splits; world_beta0_Dc0.1/seed5: all dead

verdicts.limitation: The finding's necessity holds only at the world's catalyst diffusivity Dc=1: with Dc=0.01 and no gate the bodies hold their catalyst by slow diffusion alone and metabolize and divide. So the shell is one way to keep a self-made catalyst, not a requirement; a matched lowered-D control is needed before calling it beyond diffusion (cf. 20261025T0901-c01-slowd-containment-law). One seed; I did not scan Dc between 0.1 and 0.01.
